response.sql: WITH joined AS (SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune, f.rebtotal, (f.rebrate - f.feerate) / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0) AS relgap FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rebtotal) AS overall_avg FROM joined), grp AS (SELECT orderslink, ordertune, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG(relgap) AS avg_relative_gap FROM joined GROUP BY orderslink, ordertune) SELECT g.orderslink, g.ordertune, g.avg_rebate, g.avg_relative_gap, g.avg_rebate - o.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE g.avg_rebate > o.overall_avg ORDER BY above_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10
